evals.prompt: I need a pie chart of our team's quarterly budget for a board slide next week. Set up the chart brief so the other chart skills can use it.
evals.expected_output: Writes .agents/charts.md from the template with purpose board slide, audience board, location slide 16:9 as a guess, data source unknown or asked, and marks unknowns. Contains no raw data.
assertions: Shows the contents of .agents/charts.md following the template sections
States the purpose as a board slide in one short line
Marks unknown fields such as data source date or brand colors as unknown or as questions instead of inventing them
Does not copy raw numbers into the file; it points at a source

evals.prompt: We make weekly sales charts for a printed handout in black and white. Our brand colors are #1F4E79 and #F2A900. Write our chart context.
evals.expected_output: Records print, black and white as a constraint, stores both hex codes, flags that color alone will not separate slices in grayscale, and names a next skill such as pick-chart-colors.
assertions: Records black-and-white printing as a style rule
Says that slices need more than color to be told apart in grayscale or points to pick-chart-colors
Names a sibling skill as the next step
